reddit.title: Discover How Your Colony Communicates with You
reddit.body: We've introduced new features that allow your settlement to report its status more effectively! Check out our latest devtalk on how thought badges, problem alerts, and more enhance your city-building experience. Learn more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

posts: Exciting updates are here! Your colony will now communicate its needs and issues directly to you. Read about it in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

Your settlers will now display badges for their needs and alert you to problems in real-time. Dive into the details in our new devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

discord.content: We're thrilled to share new updates that let your colony communicate its needs and issues more clearly! Check out our latest devtalk for all the details.
